WVC-M2-04-A01.basis: Actual source/existing-final hash sentinels survive success, native failure, source=nominal-final, trailing destination aliases, rename/skip races, locked promotion and two concurrent workers on both actual Windows hosts.

WVC-M2-04-A02.basis: Three real native barrier scenarios launch two PowerShell workers with the same source basename and distinct reserved media paths. Rename preserves both payloads with/without an existing final; skip leaves one final and retains the other partial. Two-argument File.Move refuses an existing final; destination-exists retry starts from the original nominal basename.

WVC-M2-04-A03.basis: Native/start/missing-output failures produce no new finished final. Media is never deleted by pathname; foreign/replaced media, sibling artifacts, foreign records and junction targets are preserved. Only our reservation is released and an empty directory is deleted non-recursively. Fatal encoder termination retains even an empty job. Exact GUID job directories are excluded from recursive/explicit input discovery and reported in later output-root inspection.

WVC-M2-04-A04.basis: An actual sharing lock prevents promotion and yields Failed with retained media/provenance/stage/reason, no final and unchanged source. Collision skip retains unused media. Ownership/path/reparse/record refusal preserves artifacts. Fatal owned cleanup rethrows; console failures cannot mask it or change a recorded Published/Skipped outcome.

read_only_review: One subagent inspected task scope, output ownership/paths/collision policy, counters, interruption and native fixture resource containment. Retention/discovery, trailing-root normalization, post-outcome display failures, fatal empty-job retention, typed interruption propagation and cleanup guards were addressed. Final review found no remaining material blockers. No subagent edits/Git mutations or independent application tests.

limitations: M2-04 checks native success, a regular temporary file and no-clobber promotion. Nonempty/readable MP4, expected streams/codecs/geometry and duration validation remain M2-05; synthetic sentinels are not valid media. Structural validation cannot prove full visual/audio integrity.

Full risk gate was executed on both hosts: all executed checks passed, but exit2/Incomplete with seven manual acceptance rows and one future coverage row NotRun. No Full, Explorer, playback, cancellation, milestone or release pass is claimed.

A held independent reservation prevents accidental job collisions, not hostile regular-file substitution by another process with the same filesystem access. Media is retained rather than deleted by path. Exact GUID directory names are a reserved input namespace; arbitrary compressed/partial names remain eligible.

Output job paths crossing reparse points are refused. Local Windows sharing/junction/concurrency were tested; UNC/network atomicity, power-loss durability and every filesystem remain unaccepted. Directory creation is followed by empty/reparse checks and exclusive CreateNew reservation; uncertain allocations are retained, never adopted.

DeleteOnClose reservation is not durable crash provenance. A hard crash can leave a reserved directory without retained.json; subsequent batches report it as active/unverified without automatic adoption, recovery or deletion. Durable manifests/resume remain future work.

Existing M2-03 pipeline/fatal propagation is preserved, including typed rethrow in allocation/leftover inspection. Full Ctrl+C/console-close/graceful/tree handling remains M3-06. Only the direct owned encoder is tracked; process-start/filesystem/network operations have no total deadline.

Default libx264/veryfast/CRF22/AAC160k/faststart, height cap/no upscale, explicit stream maps, filename metadata, PS1/BAT entrypoints, menu and sequential batches remain. No product runtime/framework, quality, geometry/colour, source-change or manifest change.
